passages.title: After the film
passages.text:
Lauren: Well, what did you think?
Aaron: Most of it was brilliant. I loved the way the story kept jumping between the past and now.
Lauren: Did you? I got a bit lost in the middle.
Aaron: No, it was clear enough. And two and a half hours went really quickly. But after all that, the last five minutes were so silly! Everyone suddenly became friends and everything was fine. I expected something much cleverer.

passages.title: The concert
passages.text:
Kyle: How was the Midnight Sky concert, Freya?
Freya: The band were fantastic. They played all my favourite songs.
Kyle: So you had a great time?
Freya: Not really. There were so many people that I couldn't move, and it was so hot. I spent half the time worrying about getting out. Next time I'll get a seat upstairs, even if I can't see as well.

passages.title: A TV talent show
passages.text:
Jordan: Did you watch Star Search last night?
Molly: Of course. That girl from Cardiff was amazing. I think the singers are much better than last year.
Jordan: Really? I thought last year's were just as good. But the judges! Did you hear what they said to that old man?
Molly: Yes, that was horrible. They didn't need to laugh at him like that.
Jordan: Exactly. They should tell people what's wrong in a nicer way.

passages.title: Learning the guitar
passages.text:
Woman: I didn't know you played the guitar, Noah. How long have you been learning?
Noah: About a year. My parents always wanted me to learn the piano, but I wasn't interested.
Woman: So what changed?
Noah: My friend Dev started a band with some boys from school, and they needed a guitarist. I really wanted to be in it, so I asked for lessons for my birthday. We do music at school too, but it's only singing.

passages.title: A birthday night out
passages.text:
Sara: So, for your birthday, there's that musical at the Grand Theatre.
Neil: I'm not a big fan of musicals, you know that. What else is on?
Sara: There's a comedy night at the Arts Centre, and a modern dance show.
Neil: Comedy would be fun.
Sara: It's sold out, I'm afraid. I checked this morning.
Neil: Oh. Well, I've never seen modern dance. Let's try something new.
Sara: Great, I'll book it.

passages.title: The summer festival
passages.text:
Amira: Are you coming to the Riverside Festival with us, Tyler? Everyone's going.
Tyler: I'd love to. The bands are great this year.
Amira: So book a ticket!
Tyler: It's ninety pounds, plus the train. I've only just started my Saturday job and I'm saving for a laptop. I'll see how much I've got at the end of the month.
Amira: The camping's free, if that helps.
Tyler: That's good, but sleeping in a tent isn't my favourite thing.

questions.question: You will hear two friends talking about a film they have just seen. What did Aaron think of it?
options: a) It was much too long.
b) The story was hard to follow.
questions.explanation: Aaron says "the last five minutes were so silly" and "I expected something much cleverer." It was Lauren who "got a bit lost"; Aaron thought "it was clear enough", and the two and a half hours "went really quickly".

questions.question: You will hear a girl telling a friend about a concert. How did she feel at the concert?
options: c) Too far away from the stage
questions.explanation: Freya says "There were so many people that I couldn't move, and it was so hot" and she was "worrying about getting out". She thought "The band were fantastic", and she never complains that she couldn't see the stage.

questions.question: You will hear two friends talking about a TV talent show. What do they agree about?
options: a) The show is on too late.
c) The singers have improved this year.
questions.explanation: Jordan complains about the judges and Molly says "that was horrible. They didn’t need to laugh at him"; Jordan answers "Exactly." Only Molly thinks the singers are better; Jordan says "last year’s were just as good". Nobody mentions the time of the show.

questions.question: You will hear a boy talking about the guitar. Why did he start learning it?
options: a) He wanted to join a band.
b) It was part of his music lessons at school.
c) His parents wanted him to learn.
questions.explanation: Noah says the band "needed a guitarist. I really wanted to be in it, so I asked for lessons". His parents wanted him to learn "the piano", not the guitar, and music at school is "only singing".

questions.question: You will hear a woman and a man deciding what show to see. What do they decide?
options: b) To go to a comedy night
c) To watch a dance show
questions.explanation: Neil says "I've never seen modern dance. Let's try something new" and Sara agrees: "Great, I'll book it." Neil is "not a big fan of musicals", and the comedy night is "sold out".

questions.question: You will hear two friends talking about a music festival. What is Tyler's attitude to going?
options: a) He doesn't like the bands.
b) He isn't sure he has enough money.
c) He is excited about camping there.
questions.explanation: Tyler mentions the cost ("ninety pounds, plus the train"), says "I'm saving for a laptop" and "I'll see how much I've got at the end of the month." He says "The bands are great this year", and "sleeping in a tent isn't my favourite thing".
